trace_id.description: OpenTelemetry trace ID from the tribal_discover or tribal_explore response being rated.

query_text.description: The original discovery query that initiated the retrieval session.

returned_item_ids.description: IDs of items returned by tribal_discover in the rated session.

explored_anchor_ids.description: IDs of items used as anchors in tribal_explore calls during the session.

notes.description: Optional reasoning. What was good or what was missing?
